name: XDS / X-LAB 喜德盛 GT600
why_interesting: A mid-budget domestic gravel platform backed by unusually strong manufacturing and support evidence.
missing: Complete BOM and current sales status for the 11.5 kg SRAM Apex 1×11 build
Manufacturer maximum tire clearance, cockpit, and size-specific configuration
Current public price and purchase route for that exact build

facts.frame: Thru-axle carbon frame and carbon fork
facts.frame_material: Carbon frame, fork and seatpost for the archived SRAM Apex 1×11 build; fiber grade and construction process are not published
facts.frame_construction: Thru-axle carbon gravel chassis with carbon fork and seatpost; exact lay-up and molding process are not published
facts.stiffness_evidence: No meaningful measured stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent ride assessment was found for the archived carbon/Apex build
facts.complete_weight_basis: Exact retailer-post claim for the archived SRAM Apex 1×11 build; size, pedals, accessories, tire pressure and weighing method are not stated

source_note: An exact GT600 retailer post documents a carbon frame, fork and seatpost build at 11.5 kg with SRAM Apex 1×11, Apex HRD brakes and fitted 700×40C tires. The fitted tire does not establish maximum clearance. Current marketplace listings do not expose a selected-option price or complete specification and conflict with older aluminum/suspension-fork configurations. The older ¥6,840–7,600 reference range remains because exact generation and trim mapping are unresolved.
